exposure: Gestational age at delivery (39 weeks vs 40 weeks)
cohort: 372 pregnant women with mild gestational diabetes mellitus
finding: There were no significant differences in adverse pregnancy outcomes and neonatal outcomes in women with mild gestational diabetes between deliveries at 39 and 40 weeks.
mod_finding: The study found no significant differences in the rate of cesarean section between mild gestational diabetes patients who delivered at 39 weeks and those who delivered at 40 weeks.
